title: Duplicate Subscription Charges: Causes & Refund Policy
content: Duplicate charges typically occur when a payment webhook is retried after a timeout, even though the original charge succeeded. Refunds for confirmed duplicates are auto-approved under $50 and processed within 3-5 business days.

title: Delayed Shipments: Carrier Escalation Steps
content: If a carrier scan is missing for more than 48 hours, open a trace request with the carrier and proactively notify the customer with a revised ETA and a goodwill discount code for delays beyond 5 days.

title: Login Failures After Password Reset
content: Some users cannot log in immediately after a password reset due to a stale session token cached client-side. Clearing the session cache or waiting 60 seconds for token invalidation resolves most cases.

title: Account Ownership Transfer Process
content: Ownership transfers require identity verification from both parties and are completed within 24 hours of approval. Enterprise accounts require an additional compliance check.

title: Invoice Tax Breakdown Requests
content: Invoices missing a tax breakdown can be reissued instantly from the billing portal under 'Download Detailed Invoice'. No manual intervention is required for standard accounts.

title: Subscription Cancellation & Retention Flow
content: Cancellation requests should first surface the reason for leaving. Offer a pause option or a 20% retention discount for Pro/Enterprise tiers before finalizing cancellation.
